_note: Rooster van aftreden (retirement schedule) + Termijnregelingen (term rules) — appended onto the bundled src/manifest.json by main.js::mergeManifestFragments (ADR-037). Index + detail pages for rooster-van-aftreden and termijn-regeling, plus a rooster-regel index (the ordered per-body term view the dashboard expiring-terms KPI deep-links to). Schema refs BY SLUG (termijn-regeling / rooster-van-aftreden / rooster-regel), never PascalCase. The Voordrachten/VoordrachtDetail pages and menu entry were removed by the appointment-decision-type-schema change — the retired voordracht schema is folded into Decision (decisionType=appointment); see that change's spec. The Dashboard 'termijnen die binnen N maanden aflopen' KPI stat widget (REQ-APT-012) lives in the base src/manifest.json (design D6/mergePages replaces a same-id page wholesale, so a fragment cannot add one widget to Dashboard without duplicating it) — out of scope for this declarative-core fragment.

pages.title: Retirement schedules
pages._note: spec: openspec/changes/appointments-and-terms/specs/appointments-and-terms/spec.md (REQ-APT-007/009/012). One rooster van aftreden per governance body. Columns body (link) / gegenereerdOp / publicationDate; regenerate, CSV export, and publication actions live on the detail page (imperative RoosterService endpoints, out of scope for this declarative core).

pages.title: Retirement schedule
pages._note: spec: openspec/changes/appointments-and-terms/specs/appointments-and-terms/spec.md (REQ-APT-007). Rooster metadata (body / gegenereerdOp / publication) leads 8-wide; the ordered RoosterRegel term entries render in the Related widget with their derived term data. gegenereerdOp is shown prominently so a stale rooster is visibly stale. Audit trail is a sidebar tab.

pages.title: Term entries
pages._note: spec: openspec/changes/appointments-and-terms/specs/appointments-and-terms/spec.md (REQ-APT-008/010/012). The ordered per-regel view the Dashboard expiring-terms KPI deep-links to. Columns persoonNaam (link) / role / termijnNummer / eindeTermijnDatum / herbenoembaar / rappelStatus; quick filters on herbenoembaar. CSV export (UTF-8 BOM, end-of-term order) via ExportService + CnMassExportDialog. Term warnings (termijnNummer > max) are conveyed in text, not colour alone (WCAG 2.1 AA).

pages.title: Term entry
pages._note: spec: openspec/changes/appointments-and-terms/specs/appointments-and-terms/spec.md (REQ-APT-006/010). Derived term data leads 8-wide; the linked rooster and source membership render as resolved references in the Related widget. Audit trail is a sidebar tab.
